method.mechanical_fields: computed by script: sha256 of A (all 35 equal the NEON sha recorded in old originals.json/repair.json where recorded); NEON-vs-A diff after comment strip + whitespace-collapse (line) and C-token SequenceMatcher (token); ptr_ops intrinsic names; set comparison with __riscv_* names in old impl/testRVV.c only (old helpers in shim/*.c not counted, so overlap is a lower bound)
method.qualitative_fields: read from old package files (repair.json/repair.md/patches/spec.c/Coq .v names) and Bopt source; [V]=read in cited file, [I]=inference, not executed. Counterexamples marked [I] are hand-derived and NOT run.
method.no_new_verification: No QCP/Coq/native run was performed. Old checker records are historical, not fresh.

rating_rubric.high: old NEON proof targets A byte-identical or only QCP syntax compat; spec.c + kernel Coq models reusable; Bopt equivalence plausible; RVV side still rebuilt (pointer-form shim)
rating_rubric.medium: substantial models/spec reusable, but at least one of: NEON proof targets a semantically repaired or heavily refactored A; Bopt likely non-equivalent under the old observation (known witness) or needs an unadopted precondition; many new RVV families
rating_rubric.low: NEON proof tied to heavily refactored/repaired A AND Bopt changes algorithm/order/semantics; only FP/integer models and witnesses transfer

global_pitfalls: Old RVV formal models are flat per-lane structs (u8-vclamp: packed 32 uint32 words) with no proven struct<->array correspondence; old shim contracts are specialized to old call sites and LMUL; pointer-form shim must be rebuilt (as in E1 f32-vadd).

QCP 2.1.4 --arch=64 parses unsigned long as UINT32 (qs8-vadd-minmax/proof/type-width-repair.json); old project typedef size_t as unsigned long long. Bopt lowering ptr_ops declare vl as "unsigned long" -> check width model.
QCP cast elision u16->s16 (qu8-vadd-minmax/proof/unsigned16-decode-repair.json) affects Bopt vreinterpret/(int16_t) casts.

QCP front-end gaps forced compat edits on A: do-while, static locals, trailing initializer comma, hex float literals, post-increment in args, nested vector calls, restrict casts. Original A needs the same edits (disclose as compat, not repair).

Many Bopt files drop old-project repairs: NaN min/max/clamp (vmax, vmin, gemm, igemm, qc4w, maxpool, dwconv-minmax, dwconv2d-chw, hwc2chw), f16 NaN path, clamp order (s8/u8-vclamp), 2^31 int count (argmaxpool), packed weight stride (dwconv-minmax), width-0 (transpose), signed *output += (qs8-rsum). Old witnesses should be replayed natively on A vs Bopt before any proof work; do not add NaN-free or lo<=hi preconditions silently.
